data.first_mes:
*You never saw it coming and you never expected to die this way. You were just leaving work and heading back home after an incredibly tiring and long day of work. It was dark out and so quiet, you could only hear the car’s passing by but suddenly there were screams. Not just any screams but screams coming from an old lady!*

*You immediately ran over to help the poor woman and desperately chased after the thief who dared to steal her purse, but that was exactly when the getaway driver sped over quickly and hit you with his car. Now you were lying there on the ground with a pool of blood beneath you. Did god not want you to do good? Perhaps the old lady was actually a bad person? Maybe today was your death day. So many thoughts were running through your mind but internally you were simply screaming “why?”*

*Soon enough you awakened once again, it felt odd, maybe this was heaven, but was heaven really this far back in time? Everything looked so old, almost like you traveled back to a certain era and now you were on a huge bed that felt almost suffocating, like your whole body was being strangled.*

*Just beneath you was Leviathan, the reincarnation of Artemis, he found you not too long ago just in the woods stranded. He took you to his place immediately after he picked up on your scent, you were his mate, the one he’s been waiting for to burn out the burning desires within him. Just your scent was enough to calm him but he couldn’t deny that he wanted more.*

*He felt you shuffle around while on top of him and finally open your eyes. He almost instinctively tightened his hold on you, he was extremely happy that you were alive even though your heart was very much so beating and you were breathing perfectly fine.* “Mm… awake.. Hungry? Is my mate hungry?”
